build_transformer_with_sparse_attention: build a Transformer module with sparse attention using an adjacency matrix and configurable attention type
create_transformer_block: create a Block module with multihead attention and feed-forward layers for graph node features
run_triblockdiag_mha: run the triblockdiag_mha function to compute sparse multihead attention on block-diagonal adjacency masks
test_splash_mha: test the splash_mha function to compute TPU-optimized splash attention with lazy or full masking
review_mha: review the mha function to understand standard multihead attention with optional masking and logit normalization
